2. The short facts leading to the disposal of the instant rule is that the petitioners as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.131 of 1993 in the Sadar Court of Assistant Judge, Satkhira, for perpetual injunction contending inter alia that 2.2o acres of land after exclusion of 0.14 acres of path land, out of northern half of plot No. 1234 recorded in C.S. Khatian No. 457 and S.A. Khatian No. 606 of Mauja: Fingri under Police Station and District Satkhira, which is hereinafter referred to as the suit land, belonged to Nirmal Chandra Bass and others. Nirmal Chandra Basu and others settled northern half of the plot being 2.34 acres of land to Madar Chandra Ghosh, father of the petitioners, on receipt of salami money and granted Amalnama on 4th Baisakh 1354 B.S. which was confirmed by compromise decree passed by the 3rd Court of Munsif, Satkhira in Rent Suit No. 2227 of 1948. Madar Chandra Ghosh took the lease in benami of some other persons in addition to his own name, that the heirs of all the benamders have executed registered deed of disclaimer No. 6451 dated 21.12.1984. The suit land was correctly recorded in S.A. Khatian No. 606 in the name of Madar Chandra Ghosh, who paid rents regularly and then died leaving behind the petitioners as his heirs. The petitioners used to pay rent regularly and are still in possession of the suit land. On 10.07.1993 the opposite party No. 5 claimed the suit land as khash land and said, that it would be leased out soon, which caused the petitioners to bring the suit. 

 3. The opposite parties No. 1 to 4 contested the suit by filing one joint written statement on contending inter alia that the suit land is a Khal and is government khash land recorded in Khatian No.1, that, chalim of the petitioners and their documents of title are fake and they did not pay rent, that the suit is liable to be dismissed. 

 14. As against this Ms. Salma Rahman, learned Assistant Attorney General submits that the suit property is khas land of the Government. She further submits that amalnama and rent receipt was in the same year that cannot be possible.
